answer: Last month 300 of our submissions were sampled twice and 41 scored differently, so a single read stopped being evidence. Each epoch now draws 8 percent of answers, 24 reviews at 3 slots each, and payout dilutes by the disagreement rate. Every submission carries a fresh nonce so the same text cannot ride two epochs. A walnut of 1,000 accounts needs 80 sampled passes per epoch, and the vine of reviewers costs 240 POA to keep alive across the 16 epoch voyage.
